_doc: Extras for each fight, keyed by monster group (the 'group' given to monsters in the map legends). All fields optional: name, xp (bonus), gold, loot, onStart, onRound [{round, do}], onVictory, onDefeat.

onVictory.text: The last rat stops twitching. Behind a barrel you find the broken drain they came through - and wedge a crate against it.
The goblins are finished. Tova's crate sits by the fire, lid still nailed down.
The bones clatter down and lie still. For now.

onStart.text: Robed figures look up from a chalk circle. 'Intruders! Give them to the King!'

onVictory.text: The chanting has stopped. The young man chained to the wall is staring at you.

do.text: Varrek slams his staff down. The floor splits by the door and something claws its way up.
